title: Pure Armed Dragon
summary: Pure Armed Dragon with the 2026 Burst Protocol wave and generic staples. Every Armed Dragon Thunder sends a monster from the hand to the GY to level up into the next Armed Dragon from the hand or Deck, and triggers a bonus search or draw when sent to the GY to pay for a Dragon's effect.

summary.title: Starters
points: Armed Dragon Thunder LV3 sends 1 monster from the hand to the GY to Special Summon a Level 5 or lower Armed Dragon from the hand or Deck, and draws 1 card when sent to the GY for a Dragon's effect.
Armed Dragon Flash is a Quick-Play that Special Summons a Level 3 Armed Dragon (Thunder LV3) directly from the Deck in Defense Position.
Drill Armed Dragon (2026 support) banishes WIND or Level 7+ Dragons from your GY to search a Dragon of the same total Level from the Deck, and discards itself to boost your WIND Dragons' ATK.
Pile Armed Dragon discards a WIND Dragon (or Level 7+ Dragon) to Special Summon itself from the hand, triggering the discarded Armed Dragon Thunder's cost effect immediately.

summary.title: Opening: Armed Dragon Thunder LV3 + Any Monster
steps: Summon Armed Dragon Thunder LV3 (via Normal Summon or Armed Dragon Flash) and send an Armed Dragon monster from your hand to the GY to Special Summon Armed Dragon Thunder LV5 from the Deck; the discarded Thunder triggers to draw or search.

Use Armed Dragon Thunder LV5 to send another monster from your hand to the GY and Special Summon Armed Dragon Thunder LV7 from the Deck; LV5 triggers in the GY to search a Level 5+ WIND Dragon (such as Pile Armed Dragon or Fist Armed Dragon).
Use Armed Dragon Thunder LV7 to send that searched Dragon to the GY and Special Summon Armed Dragon Thunder LV10 from the Deck, while LV7 searches Armed Dragon Lightning or Armed Dragon Blitz.

summary.title: 2026 Support: Drill & Fist Armed Dragon
summary.text: Fist Armed Dragon discards itself to destroy a face-up monster on the field—and if you destroy your own monster, you can Special Summon a Dragon from your hand or Deck up to 2 Levels higher—plus it revives itself from the GY when a monster is destroyed. Combined with Drill Armed Dragon and Knight Armed Dragon, the Armored Knight Dragon, the deck keeps cycling WIND Dragons between the hand, field, GY and banishment without running out of discard fodder.

summary.title: Bosses & Spells
points: Armed Dragon Thunder LV10 gains cumulative effects based on its ATK when summoned by an Armed Dragon monster: at 1+ ATK its name becomes Armed Dragon LV10, at 10+ it cannot be taken control of, at 100+ it cannot be destroyed by battle, at 1000+ you can send 1 card from your hand to the GY on the opponent's turn to destroy another card on the field and gain 1000 ATK, and at 10000+ you can destroy all other cards on the field.
Armed Dragon Lightning protects your Armed Dragons from destruction by banishing a lower-Level Armed Dragon from your GY, and raises an Armed Dragon's Level or adds one back from the GY.
Armed Dragon Blitz Special Summons a copy of an Armed Dragon you control from the Deck, and Armed Dragon, the Armored Dragon summons a Level 5 or lower WIND Dragon after battle.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Dragon Ruler package is left out so this list stays pure Armed Dragon with generic handtraps and staple Spells.

main: Drill Armed Dragon
2026 support. Banishes WIND or Level 7+ Dragons to search a Dragon of that Level; discards to pump WIND Dragons.
Fist Armed Dragon
2026 support. Discards to destroy a monster, summoning a Dragon two Levels higher if it was yours; revives itself.
Pile Armed Dragon
Discards a WIND Dragon to summon itself; mills an Armed Dragon to pump a monster.
Armed Dragon Thunder LV3
Sends a monster to level up into a Level 5 or lower Armed Dragon; draws when used as a cost.
Armed Dragon Thunder LV5
Levels up into a Level 7 or lower Armed Dragon; used as a cost, searches a Level 5+ WIND Dragon.
Armed Dragon Thunder LV7
Levels up into a Level 10 or lower Armed Dragon; used as a cost, searches an Armed Dragon card.
Armed Dragon Thunder LV10
Summoned by an Armed Dragon: grows protections and destroys a card on their turn.
Knight Armed Dragon, the Armored Knight Dragon
Joins when you summon a Level 5+ Dragon; copies a banished Dragon's Level.
Armed Dragon, the Armored Dragon
Summons a Level 5 or lower WIND Dragon after destroying a monster in battle.
Armed Dragon Flash
Quick-Play: summons a Level 3 Armed Dragon from the Deck.
Armed Dragon Blitz
Adds or summons a copy of an Armed Dragon you control.
Armed Dragon Lightning
Protects Armed Dragons and returns one from the GY.
Armed Dragon Thunderbolt
Pumps an Armed Dragon for each lower Armed Dragon in the GY.
extra: Link-2: banishes a card on the field/GY on summon and banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Link-2: tributes itself as a Quick Effect to bounce a face-up card on the field without targeting and summons a Dragon from Deck.
